args.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for letting us know. Because you've noticed a gassy smell, please treat it as serious. Please leave the flat now, don't use light switches, the oven or any flame, and open doors/windows on your way out if it's safe. Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 from outside (999 if anyone is in immediate danger). Please don't use the oven until it has been checked. We're arranging a Gas Safe engineer as an emergency, with a target of today / within 24 hours, and the oven fault will be looked at too. We'll update you as soon as we have a confirmed time, and in any case today.
